subject: POC observability plan & success criteria - FintechX
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.example>
To: Sophie Chan <sophie.chan@fintechx.com>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.example>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: POC observability plan & success criteria - FintechX

Hi Sophie / Alex —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Per our discussion, I wanted to summarize the proposed POC observability plan and the success criteria so we can align on next steps and owners. Please reply with any changes; otherwise we’ll create the shared Drive folder and kickoff tasks.

High-level goals for the 4‑week POC:
- Validate Redwood’s end‑to‑end observability for inference (latency, throughput, error-rate) under FintechX sample traffic.
- Demonstrate meaningful dashboards and alerts that map to FintechX SLOs (95th‑pct latency, per‑route error budget).
- Verify log/trace export to your security monitoring stack and sample retention settings.

Success criteria (pass/fail checkpoints):
1) Latency: 95th percentile end‑to‑end generation latency for priority route < 250ms under target load (as defined in the evaluation plan).
2) Reliability: error rate < 0.5% sustained over 24h during steady-state tests.
3) Observability coverage: traces and per‑token metrics emitted for 100% of test requests; logs exported to your SIEM within expected schema.
4) Dashboards: 1 production overview dashboard + 3 route‑specific dashboards showing latency distribution, token counts, and KV cache hit rate.
5) Alerting: two actionable alerts (latency SLO breach and backend error surge) with documented playbooks.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope, provide dataset and traffic profile, grant access to one test account. Owner: FintechX (Sophie).
- Week 1: baseline run + instrumentation (tracing/log export). Owner: Redwood (Marcus).
- Week 2: load testing and dashboard tuning. Owner: Redwood + FintechX SRE.
- Week 3: validation run against success criteria, iterate on alerts. Owner: joint.
- Week 4: POC review, handoff and recommendations. Decision gate: pass/fail per criteria above.

Ownership and access:
- FintechX: provide representative traffic (sample dataset and request profile), grant read access to SIEM/Grafana if possible.
- Redwood: implement tracing, log export connectors, create dashboards and run load tests.

Immediate next steps (action items before EOD Friday):
- Sophie: share sample traffic file and any ingestion credentials.
- Marcus: will send the initial dashboard template and required agent config.
- Jordan/Marissa: create HubSpot task and calendar invites for weekly syncs.

Attachments: draft observability dashboard (poc-observability-dashboard.json) and success criteria spreadsheet (poc-success-criteria.xlsx).

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.example
+1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks for the clear summary. This looks good and matches what we discussed. A couple of clarifications from our side:

Subject: Re: POC observability plan & success criteria - FintechX

Thanks — adding the per‑model breakdown is straightforward. I attached the initial dashboard template and a short README describing the panels and required metric names.

Notes on instrumentation:
- We will emit the following metrics (metric names in README): request.latency.p50, request.latency.p95, request.error.rate, tokens.generated.count, kvcache.hit.rate.
- Tracing: spans will include request.id, model.name, route.name, cpu/gpu.time, and token_count as attributes.
- Logs: structured JSON lines with event_type, request.id, model.name, and error_code when applicable. We’ll push to your SIEM via the secure export connector.

I’ve attached: poc-observability-dashboard.json (Grafana JSON model) and a short checklist for access. Marcus

Attachments: poc-observability-dashboard.json (application/json)

I’ve created the HubSpot deal task and a calendar invite for the weekly POC sync (Wednesdays, 10am PT). Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FTX-2026-0042 and the Drive folder above.

If there are no objections I’ll mark the plan as final and kick things off today.

Thanks,
Jordan
